title: Application of machine learning algorithms in predicting HIV infection among men who have sex with men: Model development and validation
summary: The study used 6,346 development records and a prospective 2020 validation cohort to assess screening prediction. The result supports prediction in this surveillance setting, not infection prevention, causal inference or demonstrated clinical benefit, and the paper does not report an evaluation of a locked model.
